_source: Company Man long video, watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-19: frames 0-62 s every 4-8 s, a short burst at 108-112 s, spot samples 167-663 s (two landed on mid-roll ads and were dropped), word timings from YouTube's transcript panel (2,077 words, ~190 a minute). No sound probe (same channel and mix as P2V-vFct8FY). Our own descriptions; partial after 62 s. 376K views.

hook.firstFrame: white gradient with a retail brand logo: the channel's logo-montage ident (0-7 s)
hook.firstLine: The chain is a struggling budget Italian fast-casual known for free breadsticks.

shots.picture: channel ident: brand logos pop in around a black silhouette on white, serif channel name
the chain's logo on white, then over a waving Italian flag
stock footage of hands dipping breadsticks next to a branded cup
a competitor's restaurant sign on a brick wall, blue sky
stock footage of a street cafe table with a checked cloth, shallow focus
other chains' logos over their countries' waving flags
bar chart of three chains' locations in 2002, blue bars on a dark panel inside a red frame
storefront stock and press photos of the rival chains at dusk
the same chart for today: the subject's bar almost gone
photo of a closed-looking red restaurant building with an empty sign
bar chart of locations by state, one thin bar per state
history: archive photos, stock footage, the parent company's logo
reason card: white, 'Behind the Decline of' + logo, 'Decline' red and underlined, the reason in red, food cut-outs at the sides
food-pyramid graphics, rival chains' logos, map-like charts, stock footage
stock kitchen footage (wok flip), reason cards, a quoted CEO statement, remodel photos
owners' logos in sequence; a big dollar figure in white sliding across a stock handshake
food and storefront stock under three spoken questions to the viewer
end card: silhouette on a white-to-navy gradient with the channel name

lines.gist: pins down what the chain is by comparing it to famous chains
once level with two famous chains and courted by a burger giant
the others boomed while this one shrank to a third of its peak
the history plus five reasons it declined
a made-up name, started by a seafood chain's owner, then sold on
reason one: a pasta boom drove expansion too fast into weak sites
reason two: recessions then inflation squeezed the business
reason three: diets turned against pasta and bread
reason four: quality cuts, then a new boss rescues it
reason five: five owners treating it as a side asset, ending in a bankruptcy
questions to the viewer about value, the future and the list

ending.cta: asks viewers to comment on the reasons and the chain's future
ending.lastFrame: silhouette end card with the channel name

whyItWorks: The hook compares the subject to famous chains everyone knows, so the decline lands as a contrast.
Two identical bar charts years apart make the fall visible without any animation.
A numbered list of reasons with a branded title card each gives a long video a clear spine.
The final reason ties to a fresh news event (the owner's bankruptcy), so an old story feels current.
